remarks: This stunning newly renovated apartment, offering modern living in a freshly updated space. The brand-new kitchen boasts sleek white cabinets, beautiful corian countertops, and an island perfect for casual dining or entertaining. Enjoy top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, ideal for any home chef.  The open-concept dining room and spacious family room feature gorgeous wood floors throughout, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The apartment offers two comfortable bedrooms, along with 1.5 stylishly designed baths. Convenience is key with an in-unit washer and dryer, making laundry day a breeze. This apartment is ready to move in and offers a blend of elegance, functionality, and modern upgrades! Area rugs will be required to cover flooring, per landlord. Great location! Walk to town and minutes to schools. Two parking spots will be allocated in driveway near the owner's garage. Please note; water-paid by landlord and trash removal paid by tenants.
